Points $A$ and $C$ are shown in the picture above. Find $|\overset{\to }{AC}|.$
question.worked_solution:
From the picture, we obtain $A(0,3)$ and $C(4,0).$ So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned} & \overset{\to }{OA}=a=0i+3j, \\  & \overset{\to }{OC}=c=4i+0j.\end{aligned}
$$

Expressing $\overset{\to }{AC}$ as the difference of position vectors, we obtain:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{AC} & =\overset{\to }{OC}-\overset{\to }{OA} \\  & =c-a \\  & =(4i)-(3j) \\  & =4i-3j\end{aligned}
$$

Now, using the formula for the magnitude of a vector, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}|\overset{\to }{AC}| & =\sqrt{(4)^{2}+(-3)^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{16+9} \\  & =\sqrt{25} \\  & =5.\end{aligned}
$$
